entries.0d8b3e422c6f896a: General customers who order custom-built homes
entries.1deac73685071a54: It sells ready-built homes, selling land and buildings as a set, mainly centered on Sakai City. This is the core business of the company group, pursued under the basic policy of applying fashionable architectural design to high-quality land and quality-focused homes.
entries.239020da60db9c10: A business that handles “contract homes” from real estate companies and “custom-built homes and renovation” from general customers.
entries.2d233e0f8c1ead21: A business that plans, designs, builds and sells ready-built homes, contract homes and custom-built homes, with Sakai City, Osaka Prefecture and neighboring municipalities as its main areas. It carries out a consistent series of operations, from gathering land information, drafting business profit plans, land use planning, building planning and design, land purchasing, development applications, design work, purchasing materials and placing orders for outsourced construction, to process and construction management and repair work under after-sales service. The company is responsible, and the consolidated subsidiary Makoto design Kobo handles design work.
entries.3efba205ca6d8fec: A business that leases and manages office buildings and rental apartments owned by the company group. It is handled by the company and the consolidated subsidiary Makoto Estate.
entries.5118c18b732687d7: Handled by the 2 consolidated subsidiaries Makoto Home Service and Makoto Corporation, this business mainly brokers sales of homes for sale by the company, the parent company.

entries.604b8d2688bfb030: A business that leases and manages office buildings and rental apartments owned by the company group.
entries.846aaaf2484e428f: A business that handles “contract homes” from real estate companies and “custom-built homes and renovation” from general customers. It also uses 2 housing showrooms in Sakai City (Sumai-kan) for sales promotion.
